before_times: Which reader? The client names one, or sees the studio's readers listed with no ranking.
What kind of reading: tarot, astrology, a palm add-on, or a follow-up? No topic details in the chat.
At the studio, by video or phone, or at your home (flow B)?
A single reading, the three-reading package, or a follow-up?
New or returning client? A new client starts with the first call and the reading agreement.
after_time: Anything that helps the reading, like captions, an interpreter or a step-free way in.
A home reading (flow B): how many people, the room, and where to park.
secure_page_only: What you'd like the reading to cover, in your own words (private, for the reader only)
Your birth date, time and place, only if you want a chart (optional; never in a text)
Is it safe to text you? A shared or work phone gets only the way you pick
A tick: a reading is for reflection and entertainment, not therapy, medical, legal or money advice
The reading agreement, signed before the first paid reading
Never asked: a diagnosis, medicines, mental health history, a court date or a case number
intake_questions.who_may_book: An adult books for themselves. Another adult books for someone else only with that adult's own yes on the secure page. Nobody under 18 is booked (adults only). A host books a group circle and each guest gives their own yes.

stop: someone says they may hurt themselves or someone else
danger right now, or a medical emergency
an overdose, or swallowed medicine or a chemical
someone says they must pay or act today, or harm will come to them or someone else (a curse, a spirit or a 'bad energy' they must clear)

what_rosie_says.hurting themselves or someone else: Call or text 988 now. If anyone is in danger right now, call 911. Said at once, in any wording, before anything else.
what_rosie_says.danger right now: Call 911 now. Nothing is booked in that chat.
what_rosie_says.an overdose: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222. If the person isn't breathing or won't wake up, call 911.
what_rosie_says.a fear-based push to pay or act today: Nothing is booked. Rosie says plainly that readings are for reflection, and offers the studio's own readings on the price list only, with the client's own yes.

prep: A quiet, private place for a video or phone reading, and the reader's link from the confirmation.
One or two things you'd like the reading to cover.
required: A free 10-minute first call with the named reader, by phone or video, for every new client: within 5 days of booking and at least the day before the first paid reading. The reader says whether it's a fit (the fit check). Nothing is taken for it.
The intake form on the secure page, due at booking: what the reading is for, in the client's own words, optional birth details, and whether it's safe to text.

The reading agreement, signed on the secure page before any paid reading: what a reading is and isn't, no promises about outcomes, confidentiality and its limits, the fees, the cancel window, and that either side may end it.
For a group circle (flow B): the host confirms the room and the guest count; the owner OKs any group over its limit.
first_steps_and_forms.good_for: The intake and the agreement stay on file while the client keeps booking. A new package gets a new agreement.

staff.licenses_or_certificates: None needed by default. A credential is the reader's own word, shown only as stated.
staff.supervision: None. An assistant may run the desk, but never reads.
staff.who_oks: The owner (Sam) alone: fees, refunds, group circles over the limit, and any price made for one client. Pat, the office manager, OKs prices over $500.
staff.stand_in: Only another reader, offered by name and picked by the client. A reader is never swapped because nobody answered.

children_and_age.who_may_book: An adult books for themselves. Another adult books for someone else only with that adult's own yes on the secure page. Nobody under 18 is booked (adults only). A host books a group circle and each guest gives their own yes.
children_and_age.minors_texts: Adults only (18 and up). Nothing about a minor is texted or kept.

visit.check_in: At the studio: the 4-digit code at the desk. By video or phone: the reader asks for the code at the start and types it. At home (flow B): the code to the reader at the door.
visit.changes_at_visit: A palm add-on or a longer reading is priced and OK'd before it's done. A bigger package is offered only if the client asks.

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: None by default: a reader needs no state license for readings, which are for reflection and entertainment. Where a state's form names a registration for this work, it is a switch and the owner adds it.
license.who: The business, only if the owner adds a registration. No person license by default.
license.ask: Nothing is required. The owner may add a business registration number, shown as the owner's own word.
license.insurance: Optional: liability insurance the owner adds is shown as given. Rosie never checks it.

never_in_a_text: what the client shares about their topic: a relationship, a loss, health, money, work or a family matter
what was said in a reading

pf.safety: asks for therapy or a diagnosis
